reasons: Direction is correctly assessed: § 7.2 obliges Customer to disclose and match better third-party offers for Vendor's benefit, i.e., a reverse MFN/ROFR running against us, which the rule prohibits (only Vendor-granted MFN is acceptable).
Deletion of the entire § 7.2 is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position, since the paragraph consists solely of the offending obligation and no Vendor-granted MFN is embedded in it.

Comment is accurate and correctly scoped: it explains the change, cites the playbook position, notes the genuine conflict with § 12.3's no-most-favoured-customer acknowledgment, and offers the narrow fallback (single product, 12 months, comparison carve-outs) without lecturing.
Deterministic check passes and the high changed-character ratio is inherent to a justified deletion of the clause.
